_comment_about_this_file: Reference for connecting one MCP client to multiple platform bridges at once. Merge the mcpServers block into ~/.claude.json (NOT ~/.claude/settings.json). winpc-gui (v0.2), macbox-gui (v0.3), and android-gui (v0.4) are real; entries prefixed with _planned are roadmap placeholders and won't be loaded by Claude Code (the prefix is illegal in MCP server names).

_legend.android-gui: Android phone via PC host (v0.4.0; FastMCP on port 8768; host bridges via ADB)
_legend.iphone: iOS device (v0.5.0 planned; host on macOS)

android-gui._note: v0.4.0; android MCP server runs on a Win11/macOS HOST (not the phone). Host bridges via ADB to one phone (USB or Wireless).
